title: LALAL.AI Upload Response
description: Schema for the response of POST /api/v1/upload/, returning the source_id used by subsequent split requests.

id.description: Identifier of the uploaded source file.

source_id.description: Identifier of the uploaded source file (API v1 alias of id).

size.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.

expires.description: Unix epoch seconds when the upload will be purged (24 hours after upload).
